en: Black‑and‑white view across a calm river or lake toward a tree‑covered embankment with elegant villas and a large Gothic‑revival church featuring a very tall central spire and a smaller side spire. Swans rest and preen along the near shoreline, with overhanging trees framing the right side of the image. The sky is blank and washed out, and there are no visible printed captions or border decorations.
